title: UNI students dive deep into 150-year history through podcast project
summary_en: Throughout the spring semester, one group of 28 students worked  on a research project about the history of UNI. By the semester’s end, they shared their findings in the form of a podcast, broadcasting their lessons to the masses.
title_cn: UNI students dive deep into 150-year history through podcast project

title: What should every UNI student learn? 150 years of an evolving answer
summary_en: A new six-part digital exhibit traces nearly 150 years of general education at UNI, exploring how changing ideas about citizenship, higher education and what every college graduate should know have shaped the university’s curriculum.
title_cn: What should every UNI student learn? 150 years of an evolving answer

title: UNI Humanities Hub lecture to highlight career potential of humanities degrees
summary_en: Robert Townsend's lecture, “Set Up for Success: Making Your Humanities Degree Work,” will take place on Monday, Sept. 21, on the University of Northern Iowa campus.
title_cn: UNI Humanities Hub lecture to highlight career potential of humanities degrees
